name: Cat-back exhaust, quad tips (sport)

detach._note: Coming loose and off in a crash (garage/detach.js, physics/looseParts.js): each hit's stress on the part (condition points, by its toughness) adds up; past looseThreshold it comes loose, and one hit past detachThreshold (half that, once loose) tears it off. Loose: hinge parts swing on their origin about hinge.axis within hinge.limits (degrees; pop: rad/s the latch lets go with; open: how much the air at speed lifts it), hanging parts dangle from one of their mounts (socket frame, one picked at random) and drag on the ground; none go straight to torn off. A loose part tears off when it pulls on its fixings harder than attachStrength (N): hitting things, the air at speed, bouncing. While loose it adds looseDrag to the car's drag coefficient; torn off, its mass and aero are gone.

_note: Cat-back exhaust, quad tips (sport): quad round tips, from tools/generators/exhaust.js. It starts with the sport cat-back's sound and gains: balance them.
